battle.name: 鄴城之戰
battle.brief: 大象二年（五八〇年）四月，北周柱國尉遲迥在鄴城聚眾反隋，隋文帝以丞相王誼為行軍元帥、幷州總管韋雲起率精騎為先驅，攻城拔城，一月之內鄴城易主。卡面的亞述長矛是短柄長刃、套筒可換柄的刺擊兵器，在隋軍體系中對位的是步兵的矛與槊，與弓弩、砲石、撞車、雲梯同列，本身不決定戰果。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 大象二年（580）春，戰場落在北周最固有的心臟地帶：相州治所鄴城，即今河北臨漳一帶，漳水與滏水在其間交會，北倚太行，南當中原，東接河北諸郡，西通洛陽所在的關中通道。交戰的一方是北周舊軍功集團：上柱國尉遲迥以鄴城為巢，據相、冀、並、趙諸州之地，徵集河北鄉兵與北周宿衛舊部，一時響應者眾，眾號數十萬；北周已奉隋國公楊堅之命而國號將改，尉遲迥仍以匡扶王室為名起事，遣使遊說各州，郡縣多望風響應。另一方是新立的隋朝：文帝楊堅以關隴八柱國、十二大將的世族核心執政，京師在洛陽，調兵、發糧、徵役皆出關中與河洛。他得知鄴城舉事，罷朝失色，先下詔令天下州郡兵入京，斷其接應之路，再以丞相王誼為行軍元帥節制諸軍，幷州總管韋雲起率精騎為前驅，晉王楊廣坐鎮河陽策應。兩軍接戰的關鍵不在野外地形，而在鄴城這座囤積了河北糧秣與兵器的北方大城：城破則河北歸附者散，城不破則關中兵疲於河北水網與遠距離運糧。
countriesEn: The spring of AD 580 put the battlefield on the most deeply Zhou-seated ground the dynasty still possessed: the walled seat of Yecheng in Xiangzhou, the country of today's Linzhang in Hebei, where the Zhang and the Fu waters meet, with the Taihang range to the north, the Central Plain to the south, the Hebei commanderies to the east and the Guanzhong approach through Luoyang to the west. One side was the old Zhou military-merit group: the pillar of state Wei Chi-chiong made Yecheng his base, held the ground of Xiang, Ji, Bing and Zhao, drew on the militia of Hebei together with the old guard of the Northern Zhou, and was answered by a host numbered in tens of thousands. The Zhou had already yielded to Sui Duke Yang Jian and the dynastic name was about to change, yet Wei Chi-chiong still rose in the name of protecting the house of Zhou, sending envoys to sound out the commanderies, and most of them joined him as the word of him travelled. The other side was the new Sui: Emperor Wen, Yang Jian, at the head of the aristocratic military houses of the Eight Pillars and Twelve Generals of Guanzhong, with the capital at Luoyang, and every levy, ration and conscript drawn from Guanzhong and from the Luo and Yin river country. When he learned that Yecheng had risen he broke off court, pale with shock; the first thing he did was not to march but to order the troops of every province into the capital, cutting off any reinforcement from Hebei, and only then to appoint the chancellor Wang Yi as commander-in-chief of the field army, with the Bingzhou commander Wei Yunqi leading picked cavalry as the advance guard, while the Prince of Jin, Yang Guang, held the crossing at Heyang to cover them. What decided the contest was not the open ground but Yecheng itself, the great northern city that had accumulated the grain and the arms of Hebei: had the city fallen, the districts that had declared for Wei Chi-chiong would have scattered; had it held, the Guanzhong armies would have been worn down by the water network of Hebei and by carrying grain over a very long road.
people: 留下姓名的，多在隋廷與河北舊將兩端。尉遲迥是北周的上柱國，關隴軍事貴族出身，早年曾平宇文護之亂，與宇文氏一系的西魏、北周政權相繫數十年；起事時他自居丞相、大都督，有人勸他乘虛稱帝，他不從，只取匡扶的名分，藉以號召北周舊部與河北鄉兵。他的妻魏氏在鄴城陷落之日自殉，諸子或死於戰、或降隋後被處分，尉遲一族由此在隋朝初年斷了根。隋文帝楊堅是關隴集團的核心，父楊忠出身西魏大將門第，他以宇文泰外孫與独孤信之女的雙重姻親入仕，替宇文護理政多年，深知舊軍功集團的人脈與兵柄所在；聞變之後他最緊要的一步不是立刻出兵，而是先下詔收諸州兵入京，切斷河北諸郡倒向尉遲迥的接應。丞相王誼是此役主帥：太原祁人，隋開國功臣，以籌策見長，此前一年已奉命平定青州王穎之亂，此番再任行軍元帥，統諸軍直趨鄴城，軍中分合與攻城部署皆出其手。幷州總管韋雲起領先鋒精騎，於肥地擊破尉遲迥派出的五萬之眾，追奔至鄴，斬獲以萬計。與此同時，楊素奉命南下平定杭州高智慧、宣州汪文進之亂，說明隋廷的應變並非孤軍深入，而是多路同時收網。
peopleEn: Those whose names survive sit at the two ends of the story, the Sui court at one end and the old Zhou generals at the other. Wei Chi-chiong was a pillar of state of the Northern Zhou, born into the aristocratic military houses of Guanzhong; he had helped settle the rising of Yuwen Hu and had been bound to the Yuwen house of the Western Wei and the Northern Zhou for decades. When he rose he styled himself chancellor and commander-in-chief, and there were those who urged him to take the vacant throne and proclaim himself emperor; he refused, taking only the name of supporting the Zhou, so as to rally the old Zhou troops and the militia of Hebei. His wife Wei died by her own hand on the day Yecheng fell; his sons died in the fighting or were taken and punished after surrendering, and with them the line of the Yu Chi was cut at the root in the first years of the Sui. Emperor Wen, Yang Jian, was the core of the Guanzhong group. His father Yang Zhong came of a line of great generals of Western Wei, and Yang Jian himself entered office as a kinsman of Yuwen Tai on one side and the husband of a daughter of Dugu Xin on the other, and had handled the government for years in the service of Yuwen Hu, so that he knew exactly where the old merit houses kept their connections and their swords. On hearing of the revolt his most important step was not to send an army at once but to order the provincial troops into the capital, so as to shut off the Hebei commanderies that might otherwise go over to Wei Chi-chiong. The chancellor Wang Yi was the commander of this campaign. A native of Qi in Taiyuan and a founding meritorious minister of the Sui, he was known above all for stratagem; the year before he had already been charged with putting down the revolt of Wang Ying at Qingzhou, and now he was appointed commander-in-chief of the field army, marched straight on Yecheng, and directed the disposition of the army and the conduct of the siege. Wei Yunqi, commander of Bingzhou, led the picked cavalry of the advance guard, broke the host of fifty thousand that Wei Chi-chiong had sent out at Fei, pursued them up to Yecheng and took a count measured in tens of thousands. At the same time Yang Su was sent south to put down the risings of Gao Zhihui at Hangzhou and of Wang Wenjin at Xuanzhou, which shows that the reply of the court was not a single column pushed deep into the country but a net drawn in at several points at once.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛，是公元前九百年兩河流域城攻體系的短柄、長刃、套筒式刺擊兵器，與弓、鐵器並列，兩河流域的城一個接一個在它面前陷落。它本身並不在五八〇年的鄴城出現，但同一型制，即短柄、長刃、鐵鏃、可換柄的套筒刺擊器，正是隋軍步兵手中那件矛與槊的形制祖先。落到這場戰役的序列上，卡面兵器應當放在近戰骨幹的位置：隋軍攻城時，步兵執矛、持楯，列成密排，護著撞車與雲梯向城門逼近；守軍在城頭與街巷之間同樣靠矛、刀、楯逐開來敵。亞述長矛那種短柄好握、刃部寬長的設計，講的正是狹窄通道與登城階梯上的使用邏輯：柄短可以貼身施力，刃長可以順著盾面壓入，正好對應鄴城城門被撞車撞開、兩軍在門洞之內短兵相接的那一刻。與它同列的還有整套攻城與防禦裝備：弓、弩與機關弩壓制城頭，砲石擲打牆垛與城門，撞車、雲梯、攻城槌與穴地用的鎬斧負責破門，火箭焚燒城門上的棚屋與守軍堆積的柴草；轉運靠牛車、馬匹與漳滏水路的漕運，攻城序列的每一件器械都要先從洛陽沿官道運到鄴城下。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card belongs to the city-siege order of the Mesopotamian world of the ninth century before the common era: a short-hafted, long-bladed, socketed thrusting weapon, listed beside the bow and the iron implements with which one walled city after another in the river country fell. The specimen itself was not at Yecheng in AD 580, but the same type, a short haft, a long blade, an iron head and a socket that allows the haft to be replaced, is the direct ancestor of the form of the spear and the shao that the Sui infantry carried. Placed in the order of battle of this campaign, the weapon on the card belongs to the backbone of close combat: when the Sui attacked, the infantry carried spears and shields and marched in close order, covering the rams and the scaling ladders as they closed on the gate; the garrison used the same spear, the sabre and the shield to push the enemy back among the wall and the streets. The short haft and broad blade of the Assyrian spear express exactly the logic of use in a narrow passage or on a scaling ladder: a short haft can be driven home from close in, and a long blade can be driven in along the face of the shield, which is the moment that matters when the ram has burst the gate of Yecheng and the two sides meet at close quarters inside the gateway. Set beside it in the same order was the whole apparatus of siege and defence: bows, crossbows and mounted crossbows covering the walls, stone throwers beating the parapets and the gates, rams, scaling ladders, picks and the mattocks used in mining under the foundations, and rockets burning the sheds over the gates and the brushwood the defenders had stacked. The movement of all this rested on ox carts, on horses, and on the river transport of the Zhang and Fu waterways, and every engine of the assault had to be brought from Luoyang along the official road to the foot of Yecheng before a stroke was made.
tactics: 鄴城之役的戰術，是攻城術與騎兵機動互相咬合的樣子。尉遲迥一方守城：據鄴城四門與城郭，徵集的河北鄉兵分守城頭、街坊與郭城，弓弩手列於女牆，砲石與拒馬佈在門道，井水與倉糧支持長時間抵抗；同時他分兵四出，遣子率五萬眾北趨青州，想先打掉隋軍的側翼與糧道。隋軍則不急於硬撞城牆：行軍元帥王誼自洛陽出兵，渡黃河於河陽，沿官道北行，騎兵在兩翼先行，掃清道旁堡壘與村屯，斷絕城內與外郡的聯絡；先鋒韋雲起率精騎在肥地吃掉那支五萬之眾，追奔至鄴城下，等於替大軍掃清了攻城前的外圍。攻城階段，隋軍用撞車與雲梯同時壓向城門，穴地掘進牆基以削弱垣身，另以砲石覆蓋城頭，火箭焚燒門樓，使守軍無法在城頭重新集結；破城之後，入城兩軍在門洞與街巷中短兵相接，矛與刀的分量立刻壓過弓弩。整場戰役最要緊的節奏只有一句：先在外圍消滅敵軍主力，再把全部攻城器械集中到一城。隋唐兩代兵書中的攻城條目多出於這一類實戰經驗，河北的攻法記憶也由此而定型。
tacticsEn: The tactics of Yecheng were siegecraft and cavalry manoeuvre locked together. On Wei Chi-chiong's side it was a defence of the city: the four gates and the outer works were held by the militia levied from Hebei, bowmen on the parapet, stone throwers and chevaux-de-frise in the gate passages, wells and storehouses sustaining a long resistance; and at the same time the army was split and sent out, the son taking fifty thousand north toward Qingzhou in the hope of first breaking the flank and the supply road of the Sui. The Sui did not hurry to throw itself against the wall. The commander-in-chief Wang Yi marched out of Luoyang, crossed the Yellow River at Heyang and went north along the official road, the cavalry working the wings ahead of the column and clearing the fortified farms and villages along the way so as to cut the city off from the commanderies behind it; the advance guard under Wei Yunqi destroyed the host of fifty thousand at Fei and pursued it to the foot of Yecheng, which was in effect the removal of everything outside the walls before the siege began. In the assault itself the Sui drove rams and scaling ladders against the gates at the same time, mined under the base of the wall to weaken the masonry, used stone to sweep the parapets and rockets to burn the gate towers, so that the defenders could not reform on the walls; once the city was entered the two sides met at close quarters in the gateways and the streets, and the weight of the spear and the sabre quickly counted for more than the bow. The whole rhythm of the campaign comes down to one thing: destroy the enemy's field army outside first, then concentrate every engine of assault on the single city. The siege sections of the military manuals of the Sui and the Tang draw largely on experience of this kind, and the memory of how Hebei was fought was fixed in it.
data: 可以核對的數字不算多，但足以看出這場兵變的規模。時間上，索引把本役繫於公元五八〇年四月；正史則記尉遲迥據鄴反在開皇十年四月，鄴城陷落於其後數旬之內，兩說所指為同一場河北兵亂，正文以兵亂本身的經過為準。兵力方面，尉遲迥一方的聲勢被寫成眾數十萬，這類數目在北周、隋的文書裡多屬概數，只宜當作量級看待；能對得上的是分兵的部分，他遣子率兵五萬北趨青州。隋軍方面，史料記前鋒精騎以萬計，帥軍則由丞相與幷州總管各領一軍，另有宿衛與諸州勤王之師。戰果方面，肥地一戰斬首以萬計，懷州方向再斬首以萬計，並有溺斃者甚眾；鄴城陷落時，潰散與被執的部眾亦以萬計。距離上，洛陽至鄴的官道路程約五百里，騎兵疾行十日上下可達，步騎大軍則要更久；鄴城距黃河渡口河陽約二百餘里，這一線的糧道全靠水陸接運。時間跨度上，從四月舉事到鄴城易主約一個月上下；其後平定懷州與收撫響應諸州，又用去數月。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are not many, but they are enough to show the scale of the rising. In time: the index files this engagement under the fourth month of AD 580, while the standard histories place the occupation of Yecheng by Wei Chi-chiong in the fourth month of the tenth year of the Kaihuang era, with the city falling within a few tens of days after that, the two reckonings pointing to the same rising in Hebei, and the account here following the substance of the rebellion itself. As to strength: the force of Wei Chi-chiong is described as a host of tens of thousands, and figures of that kind in the documents of the Zhou and the Sui are usually round numbers, to be read only as an order of magnitude; what can be matched is the detachment sent out, for he despatched his son with fifty thousand toward Qingzhou. On the Sui side the records give the picked cavalry of the advance guard as numbering in the thousands, the main command being divided between the chancellor and the Bingzhou commander, with the imperial guard and the relief armies of the provinces besides. As to results: the action at Fei is credited with tens of thousands of enemy dead, the drive against Huaizhou with tens of thousands more, together with a great many drowned; and when Yecheng fell, the troops that scattered or were taken are likewise counted in tens of thousands. In distance: the official road from Luoyang to Yecheng runs about five hundred li, some 250 kilometres, which cavalry could cover in ten days or so at a forced pace while the combined foot and horse column took longer; Yecheng lies a little over two hundred li from the crossing of the Yellow River at Heyang, and the supply line of that approach ran by water and by land. In span: from the rising in the fourth month to the change of hands at Yecheng took about a month, and the reduction of Huaizhou and the pacification of the responding commanderies took several months more.
cause: 打起來的緣由，一半在體制，一半在人心。體制這一層：北周是靠八柱國、十二大將一系世族建立起來的關隴軍功政權，國祚不長，靠的是分封功臣與將門子弟掌握兵柄。隋國公楊堅以姻親與軍功入樞，平定宇文護兄弟的權爭，北周靜帝退位，國號將改，關隴諸將舊日分封的田邑與部曲也開始被收攏。舊軍功集團最怕的不是改朝換代，而是自己被當成可以裁汰的對象；尉遲迥位望最高、兵柄最重，是最可能先被動手的那一個。人心這一層：鄴城是北周的起家之地與北方都會，河北鄉兵强悍，府兵在關中而丁口在河北，關中對河北的調度需要時間；一旦有北周柱國在鄴城豎起旗幟，河北各州郡的觀望就會變成響應。導火線則是具體的人事：尉遲迥不滿朝局，以匡扶為名聚兵於鄴，遣使遊說各州，郡縣望風而應。隋廷的反應也快：文帝聞變罷朝震懼，一面接納各州入朝之兵以封鎖河北，一面向天下宣布討逆、許以官賞，把鎮壓變成有獎賞的義務，於是此戰既是反叛，也是隋朝收編河北的一次政治動作。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting lay half in the institutions and half in the mood of men. The institutional layer: the Northern Zhou was a Guanzhong military-merit polity raised by the houses of the Eight Pillars and Twelve Generals; its short dynastic life rested on enfeoffing meritorious servants and on the sons of the great families holding the swords of the state. Sui Duke Yang Jian entered the centre of power through marriage and military merit, having settled the contest for power between the Yuwen Hu brothers; the Zhou emperor had been pushed back and the dynastic name was about to change, while the old fiefs and private retinues of the Guanzhong houses were already being drawn in. What the old merit group feared was not the change of dynasty but the discovery that it was itself to be cut; Wei Chi-chiong, of the highest standing and the heaviest command, was the likeliest to be handled first. The layer of feeling: Yecheng was the cradle of the Northern Zhou and the great city of the north. The militia of Hebei was hardy, the households that furnished the fu-bing were in Hebei even though the fu-bing itself stood guard in Guanzhong, and every transfer of troops from Guanzhong to Hebei took time; once a pillar of Zhou had raised a banner at Yecheng, the waiting of the Hebei commanderies turned into assent. The spark was a matter of men and measures: dissatisfied with the state of the court, Wei Chi-chiong gathered troops at Yecheng in the name of protection and sent envoys to sound out the commanderies, which declared for him as the word travelled. The answer of the court was quick as well. The emperor broke off court in shock; he admitted the provincial troops into the capital to seal off Hebei, and at the same time proclaimed the suppression of the rebellion throughout the realm with offices and rewards for those who joined, turning the suppression into an obligation with a price attached. The war was therefore at once a rebellion and a political act by which the Sui gathered in Hebei.
impact: 鄴城之戰的直接後果，是隋朝把北周最後一次大規模的舊軍功反扑壓了下去，河北自此在一個世代之內不再能單獨與京師抗衡。第一層是兵制：平叛之後，隋廷把河北各州郡的兵與將校收編入府兵與州府體系，宿衛與鄉兵的編制重新登記，舊日世族部曲的私人武裝被逐步拆散；此後隋的實力可以集中調往江南與塞北，開皇十一年之後才有足夠的資源大舉滅陳。第二層是政權性格：從此隋文帝的用人取向明顯偏向關隴與河南的新進文吏，河北舊族在軍政兩界的分量一落千丈，河北之於中央從獨立勢力變成屏障與兵源之地，這層戒心後來在唐代的河北道與藩鎮問題上一再顯影，成為歷代王朝的痼疾。第三層是後勤與技術：這場攻城戰把撞車、雲梯、穴地、砲石與火箭的配合程式反覆磨練，隋唐兵書中的攻城條目多出於這一類實戰經驗；而短柄矛、槊這一類近戰兵器，始終是步兵的骨幹，直到唐軍的裝備帳籍裏，它仍與刀、弓弩並列。戰爭同時把隋初的民生壓力暴露無遺：關中饑荒與河北兵亂同年而至，開皇二年蘇威因主張開倉賑饑而得罪罷相，說明一場邊地兵事背後的倉廩有多薄。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of Yecheng was that the Sui crushed the last great rising of the old Zhou military-merit group, and for a generation Hebei could no longer stand by itself against the capital. The first layer is military: after the suppression the troops and commanders of the Hebei commanderies were taken into the fu-bing and the prefectural system, the households of the guard and of the militia were re-registered, and the private armed bands of the old great families were broken up step by step; from then on the strength of the Sui could be moved towards the south and the northern frontier, and it was only after the eleventh year of Kaihuang that there were means enough for the great campaign against the Chen. The second layer is the character of the regime: from that point the preferences of Emperor Wen turned clearly towards the new civil officials of Guanzhong and of Henan, the weight of the old Hebei houses in both the army and the administration fell away, and Hebei changed from an independent power into a screen and a source of recruits for the centre. That wariness showed itself again and again in the Hebei circuit and the regional military governors of the Tang, and became one of the recurring ailments of Chinese dynasties. The third layer is logistics and technique: this siege ground the combination of ram, scaling ladder, mine, stone and rocket into a set formula, and the siege sections of the Sui and Tang military manuals draw largely on experience of this kind. The short-hafted spear and the shao, meanwhile, remained the backbone of the infantry, and in the Tang armory tallies they are still listed beside the sabre, the bow and the crossbow. The campaign also laid bare the thinness of the first years of the Sui: famine in Guanzhong and revolt in Hebei came in the same year, and Su Wei was dismissed from office in the second year of Kaihuang for arguing that the granaries should be opened to relieve the hungry, which shows how little store the state had behind a war on its own frontier.
result: 結果是隋朝完勝。鄴城在起事後約一個月內被攻破，尉遲迥自盡於城，諸子或死或降，妻魏氏同日殉死；韋雲起破其援軍於肥，隋軍再取懷州，響應的郡縣陸續平定。善後的殺戮極重：尉遲一族的宗族數百人因此被誅或流徙，鄴城為河北軍資重地，城中府庫兵器一併收繳。政治上的獎賞則落到主帥頭上：王誼以行軍元帥首功加封進爵，入為相位，開皇十四年薨於任上；韋雲起以先鋒之功拜為大將，宿衛重地。對北周舊集團而言，這場兵變是一次徹底的失敗：它證明關隴世族在隋的體制下已經無法用兵說話，於是北周留下的武裝傳統轉為隋唐的府兵制與關隴集團，隨後在開皇年間南下滅陳、貞觀年間再定天下，成為唐帝國的骨架。鄴城本身也沒有退場：它仍是河北的中心，開皇二十年楊廣即位後，漢王楊諒在並州舉兵反隋，兵鋒又指向河北，鄴與河陽一線再度成為戰場。隋文帝當年用一座城、一次攻城、一場速決，買下了整個河北的服從，也留下一個王朝對北方腹地始終不放心的傳統。
resultEn: The result was a complete Sui victory. Yecheng was taken within about a month of the rising; Wei Chi-chiong killed himself in the city, his sons died or surrendered, and his wife Wei died by her own hand the same day. Wei Yunqi broke his relief army at Fei, the Sui took Huaizhou next, and the commanderies that had answered the call were reduced one after another. The reprisals were severe: several hundred members of the Yu Chi clan were put to death or exiled, and the storehouses and armoury of Yecheng, a great depot of military material in the north, were taken over wholesale. The rewards in the political sphere went to the commander: Wang Yi was raised in rank and enfeoffed for his victory as commander-in-chief and entered the chancellorship, dying in office in the fourteenth year of Kaihuang, while Wei Yunqi, whose service had been as advance guard, was made a general and posted to the imperial guard. For the old Zhou group the rising was a total failure. It showed that the aristocratic houses of Guanzhong could no longer speak through arms under the Sui order, and the martial tradition the Zhou left behind passed into the fu-bing system of the Sui and the Tang and into the Guanzhong group, which marched south to defeat the Chen in the Kaihuang years and settled the realm again in the Zhenguan years, forming the skeleton of the Tang empire. Yecheng itself did not leave the stage either: it remained the centre of Hebei, and after Yang Guang took the throne in the twentieth year of Kaihuang the Prince of Han, Yang Liang, rose in revolt at Bingzhou and turned his weapons toward Hebei once more, putting Yecheng and the line of the Heyang crossing back on the field of battle. With one city, one siege and one swift decision, Emperor Wen of the Sui bought the submission of all Hebei, and also established a tradition of a dynasty that was never at ease about the northern heartland.
